limitations: HubSpot requires creating a dedicated Developer Account separate from standard HubSpot portals. Public apps listed on the App Marketplace require HubSpot App Certification.

assumptions: Developer has created a free HubSpot Developer Account
Configuring standard OAuth 2.0 app with crm.objects.contacts scopes

externalWait.publishedRange: Instant for unlisted public apps (installable via direct URL); 2–4 weeks for App Marketplace certification

prerequisites.text: HubSpot Developer Account (free signup at developers.hubspot.com)

steps.title: Create an App in HubSpot Developer Account
steps.instructions: Go to `https://app.hubspot.com/developer` and open your developer account. Click 'Manage apps' > 'Create app'. Enter public app details such as App Name, Logo, and Description.
steps.completionCheck: App dashboard displays App ID and credentials.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URLs & Scopes in Auth Tab
steps.instructions: In your app settings, switch to the 'Auth' tab. Under 'Redirect URLs', add your callback URL (e.g. `https://app.example.com/api/auth/callback/hubspot`). Under 'Scopes', select required CRM permissions such as `crm.objects.contacts.read` and `crm.objects.contacts.write`. Click 'Save'.
steps.completionCheck: Redirect URL saved; scope requirements locked.

steps.title: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
steps.instructions: In the same Auth tab, locate 'Client ID' and 'Client secret' (click 'Show secret'). Store both in your application environment configuration (`HUBSPOT_CLIENT_ID` and `HUBSPOT_CLIENT_SECRET`).
steps.completionCheck: Client ID and secret securely stored.

steps.title: Generate Install URL & Execute Token Exchange
steps.instructions: Generate your install URL: `https://app.hubspot.com/oauth/authorize?client_id={CLIENT_ID}&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}&scope={SCOPES}`. After user installs, exchange the authorization code by making a POST request to `https://api.hubapi.com/oauth/v1/token` with `grant_type=authorization_code`.
steps.completionCheck: Valid access_token and refresh_token returned by HubSpot API.

claims.text: HubSpot apps must be created inside a dedicated HubSpot Developer Account at app.hubspot.com/developer.
HubSpot apps define explicit redirect URLs and granular CRM object scopes in the Auth tab.
HubSpot issues confidential Client Secrets used for server-to-server token exchange.
Token exchange is executed via POST to https://api.hubapi.com/oauth/v1/token with content-type application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
